source_byte_selection: first 8MiB of gzip, not random or whole transcriptome
filtering: minimap2 short-read mapping to 26 2020 Cirsium japonicum BLAST-annotated candidate transcripts and 26 shuffled nucleotide decoys; MAPQ>=20, aligned_nt>=90, NM/aligned_nt<=0.20; primary hit only
source_candidate_trio_status: DFR, ANS and related families not functionally certified
interpretation: First source-backed evidence that a 2026 Cirsium brevicaule young-leaf R1 prefix contains 53 reads similar to fragments of Park 2020 Cirsium japonicum BLAST-annotated candidate transcripts (14 to TR39766), under narrow selected-reference mapping. Does not imply function, gene copy, heritable pigment capacity or historical gain.
